query: We’re a family of five. My in-laws who are both in their 60s, and our 8 year old planning a 10 day trip across Uttar Pradesh sometime in November. We want to cover Varanasi, Agra, and Lucknow, maybe Ayodhya towards the end if time allows. The main things on our list are attending the evening Aarti in Varanasi, exploring the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort, and experiencing the old Nawabi culture and food trails in Lucknow at least once. My in-laws are not great walkers, so we need a comfortable vehicle and a driver who’s patient and understands senior travel needs. Hotels should ideally have lifts and be senior friendly.
query_summary: A family odyssey through Varanasi's spirituality, Agra's marvels, and Lucknow's regal charm, all tailored for leisurely exploration and enriching encounters.
